```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)


theme_set(theme_cowplot())

# Helper: reshape a named gene list into a DT-ready data.frame
geneset_dt <- function(lst, group_col = "group") {
  df <- stack(lst)
  names(df) <- c("gene", group_col)
  DT::datatable(df[, c(group_col, "gene")],
                rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollY = "400px",
                               scrollCollapse = TRUE))
}

# Helper: plotly UMAP scatter coloured by a UCell score column.
# scores_df is the output of extract_ucell_scores() — already contains
# UMAP1, UMAP2, and sample.name, so no Seurat object is needed.
score_scatter <- function(scores_df, col) {
  p <- ggplot(scores_df,
              aes(UMAP1, UMAP2,
                  color = .data[[col]],
                  text  = paste0("sample: ", sample.name))) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(name = "UCell score") +
    ggtitle(col) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          plot.title      = element_text(size = 11))
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
}
```

## Resource index

```{r resource-table}
targets::tar_read(geneset_study_table) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE,
                options  = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "t"))
```

---

## Summary heatmap — all genesets × cluster × sample

Average UCell score per cluster × sample for every scored geneset, row- and
column-clustered. Columns are grouped by cluster (column split); a top annotation
bar shows `sample.name`. Values are z-scored per row.

```{r summary-heatmap-data}
META_COLS <- c("cell_id", "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "sample.name")

cond_pal   <- c(WT = "#888888", `mCh-` = "#2a9d8f", `mCh+` = "#e76f51")
label_condition <- function(x) dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("WT",      x) ~ "WT",
  grepl("mCh-",   x) ~ "mCh-",
  grepl("mCh\\+", x) ~ "mCh+",
  TRUE                ~ x
)

# Load all UCell score targets
scores_list <- list(
  Nestorowa       = targets::tar_read(ucell_scores_nestorowa_hsc),
  Isobe           = targets::tar_read(ucell_scores_isobe_hsc),
  Psaila          = targets::tar_read(ucell_scores_psaila_hsc),
  Pan             = targets::tar_read(ucell_scores_pan_hsc),
  `Gavish meta`   = targets::tar_read(ucell_scores_gavish_meta_hsc),
  `Gavish cancer` = targets::tar_read(ucell_scores_gavish_cancer_hsc)
)

# Cluster column from annotation_recluster_hsc
clust_df <- targets::tar_read(annotation_recluster_hsc)
clus_col <- grep("res_5|res\\.5$", colnames(clust_df), value = TRUE)[1]
clust_df <- clust_df[, c("cell_id", clus_col)]
colnames(clust_df)[2] <- "cluster"

# Average UCell score per cluster × sample.name per geneset
avg_rows <- lapply(names(scores_list), function(study) {
  df         <- scores_list[[study]]
  score_cols <- setdiff(names(df), META_COLS)
  df |>
    dplyr::select(cell_id, sample.name, dplyr::all_of(score_cols)) |>
    dplyr::left_join(clust_df, by = "cell_id") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(score_cols),
                        names_to = "geneset", values_to = "score") |>
    dplyr::group_by(cluster, sample.name, geneset) |>
    dplyr::summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(study = study)
})

all_avg <- dplyr::bind_rows(avg_rows)

# Column key: cluster__sample  (double underscore as separator)
all_avg <- all_avg |>
  dplyr::mutate(col_key = paste0(cluster, "__", sample.name))

# genesets × (cluster__sample) matrix
mat <- all_avg |>
  dplyr::select(geneset, col_key, mean_score) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col_key, values_from = mean_score,
                     values_fill = 0) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("geneset") |>
  as.matrix()

# Sort columns: cluster numerically, then sample.name within cluster
col_meta <- tibble::tibble(col_key = colnames(mat)) |>
  tidyr::separate(col_key, into = c("cluster", "sample.name"),
                  sep = "__", remove = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster_num = suppressWarnings(as.integer(cluster)),
    condition   = label_condition(sample.name)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(cluster_num, sample.name)

mat <- mat[, col_meta$col_key]

# Row-wise z-score
mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
mat_z[is.nan(mat_z)] <- 0

# ── Row annotation: study ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
study_map <- all_avg |>
  dplyr::distinct(geneset, study) |>
  dplyr::filter(geneset %in% rownames(mat_z))
study_vec <- study_map$study[match(rownames(mat_z), study_map$geneset)]

n_studies  <- length(unique(study_vec))
study_pal  <- setNames(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(n_studies, 3), "Set2")[seq_len(n_studies)],
  unique(study_vec)
)

# ── Column annotation: sample.name coloured by condition ─────────────────────
sample_vec    <- col_meta$sample.name
condition_vec <- col_meta$condition
# Per-sample colour: pick from condition palette
sample_pal <- setNames(
  cond_pal[condition_vec],
  sample_vec
)

# Column split: cluster label for each column
col_split <- factor(col_meta$cluster,
                    levels = unique(col_meta$cluster[order(col_meta$cluster_num)]))

cat("Matrix:", nrow(mat_z), "genesets ×", ncol(mat_z),
    "columns (cluster × sample)\n")
```

```{r summary-heatmap-plot, fig.height=20, fig.width=14}
col_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Condition = condition_vec,
  col       = list(Condition = cond_pal[names(cond_pal) %in% condition_vec]),
  annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
  annotation_height  = unit(4, "mm")
)

row_anno <- ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
  Study = study_vec,
  col   = list(Study = study_pal),
  annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
)

col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027")
)

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  mat_z,
  name                      = "z-score",
  col                       = col_fun,
  cluster_rows              = TRUE,
  cluster_columns           = TRUE,
  clustering_method_rows    = "ward.D2",
  clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
  top_annotation            = col_anno,
  right_annotation          = row_anno,
  show_row_names            = TRUE,
  show_column_names         = TRUE,
  row_names_gp              = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_gp           = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_rot          = 90,
  heatmap_legend_param      = list(
    title         = "z-score",
    title_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
    labels_gp     = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    legend_height = unit(3, "cm")
  )
)
```

## Nestorowa 2017 Blood

Lineage gene sets from scRNA-seq of HSC/progenitor populations. Displayed as
UMAP module scores — each score summarises mean scaled expression of the
corresponding lineage programme per cell.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Gene sets

```{r nestorowa-table}
geneset_dt(targets::tar_read(nestorowa_17_bl_mm_genesets), "lineage")
```

### Module scores

```{r nestorowa-scores}
#| results: asis
scores     <- targets::tar_read(ucell_scores_nestorowa_hsc)
score_cols <- setdiff(names(scores), c("cell_id", "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "sample.name"))
plots      <- lapply(score_cols, function(col) score_scatter(scores, col))
tagList(plots)
```

:::

---

## Kucinski 2024 Cell Stem Cell

HSPC marker genes by cell identity. T cells are excluded (absent from the
sorted HSC compartment). Each panel shows individual marker genes split by
`sample.name`.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Gene sets

```{r kucinski-table}
geneset_dt(targets::tar_read(kucinski_24_csc_mm_genesets), "cell_identity")
```

### Feature plots

```{r kucinski-plots}
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 14
srt         <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc)
lst         <- targets::tar_read(kucinski_24_csc_mm_genesets)
plot_subset <- stringr::str_subset(names(lst), "T cell", negate = TRUE)
n_avail     <- lapply(lst, function(x) sum(x %in% rownames(srt)))

lapply(lst[plot_subset][n_avail[plot_subset] > 0], function(markers) {
  FeaturePlot(srt, markers, split.by = "sample.name") &
    scale_color_viridis_c() & Seurat::RestoreLegend()
})
```

:::

## Ferchen 2026 — TF Activities

Transcription factor activity markers at `level_4` resolution. Limited to the
first 20 cell types with available TFs to keep render time manageable.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Gene sets

```{r ferchen-tf-table}
geneset_dt(targets::tar_read(ferchen_26_mm_tf_genesets), "cell_type")
```

### Feature plots

```{r ferchen-tf-plots}
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 14
lst     <- targets::tar_read(ferchen_26_mm_tf_genesets)
n_avail <- lapply(lst, function(x) sum(x %in% rownames(srt)))

lapply(names(lst)[n_avail > 0] %>% head(20), function(name) {
  FeaturePlot(srt, lst[[name]], split.by = "sample.name") &
    scale_color_viridis_c() & Seurat::RestoreLegend() &
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = name)
})
```

:::

## Gavish 2023 — SCENIC Regulators (Human → Mouse)

TF regulon targets from SCENIC, mapped to mouse orthologs. Filter: ≥ 2 orthologs
present in the query.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Gene sets

```{r gavish-hs-scenic-table}

```

### Feature plots

```{r gavish-hs-scenic-plots}
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 14
lst       <- targets::tar_read(gavish_23_hs_scenic_genesets)
lst_avail <- lapply(lst, function(x) sum(x %in% rownames(srt)))

lapply(names(lst)[lst_avail > 1], function(name) {
  FeaturePlot(srt, lst[[name]], split.by = "sample.name") &
    scale_color_viridis_c() & Seurat::RestoreLegend() &
    patchwork::plot_annotation(title = name)
})

rm(srt); gc()
```
